_comment: descriptions keyed table/label; written by hand, consumed by gen_menus.py
menu_formatS11/SWR ANT: SWR at the antenna end of the feedline, corrected for the one-way cable loss entered under CABLE LOSS (or computed from CABLE TYPE and CABLE LENGTH). Blank until a loss is set.
menu_formatS11/CABLE LOSS: One-way matched loss of the feedline in dB at the band in use; feeds SWR ANT. Entering a value here selects CABLE TYPE = MANUAL.
menu_formatS11/CABLE TYPE: Coax preset (LMR-400, RG-213, RG-8X, RG-58, RG-174/316) used with CABLE LENGTH to compute the loss for SWR ANT. MANUAL uses the CABLE LOSS value.
menu_measure_swr_bw/SWR BW: Bandwidth and Q of the SWR dip nearest the active marker: f0, minimum SWR, 2:1 and 3:1 edge frequencies, Q (Yaghjian & Best, using the measured R at the dip).
